title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Cape Town grid point, 17–25 May 2026
claims: The API returned a grid point at 33.848858 S / 18.49315 E with an elevation of 12 m and timezone Africa/Johannesburg.
The request covers nine days from 17 to 25 May 2026.
Daily maximum temperatures ranged from 17.2 °C to 24.0 °C, with a median of 20.6 °C.
Daily minimum temperatures ranged from 10.6 °C to 15.5 °C, with a median of 12.7 °C.
Precipitation reached at least 1 mm on two of the nine days: 1.9 mm on 19 May and 1.2 mm on 22 May; no day reached 5 mm.
Daily maximum wind speeds ranged from 8.5 to 20.9 km/h, with a median of 12.8 km/h.
On 24 May 2026 the values were 20.6 °C maximum, 14.1 °C minimum, 0.0 mm precipitation and 11.6 km/h maximum wind.
The values are modelled grid-point data returned for the requested coordinates, not measurements taken on the race course.
